knowledge_graph.title: L'Arlequin
knowledge_graph.description: The Arlequin is a cinema in Paris, noted for its spacious modernist main theatre and its former role as a showcase of Soviet film.

related_questions.question: Are there any English language cinemas in Paris?
related_questions.snippet: Paris cinema is thriving. The 400 viewing rooms play movies in French and English. Movies in English are referenced as V.O or VOST. Movie theater showtimes are available online at Officiel des spectacles and Allociné.

related_questions.question: How much does it cost to go to the cinema in France?
related_questions.snippet: Today, the price of a cinema ticket is around 12 euros (excluding the supplement for a film in 3D). To enjoy a film without overspending, go to the capital's art house cinemas that charge reasonable rates, between 6 and 8.50 euros. Most independent Parisian cinemas can be found in the Latin Quarter.
